description: Webview needs core:event only: ui/main.js calls listen() for progress/op-result/close-refused. The three custom commands (run_install, run_uninstall, save_diagnostics) are not ACL-gated -- there is no app/permissions/ directory, so has_app_acl_manifest stays false and they are allowed unconditionally, same as before this file existed. The save dialog is invoked from Rust (DialogExt, never crosses IPC), so no dialog:* permission belongs here.
